{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] titled '''''The Bounty Hunters' Guild's Greatest Hits: Volume VII''''' was a collection of holovids, published by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The holofilm contained a collected edition of recorded assassinations. Thereby even the guild's leader [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] and his son [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] appeared in some of the holovids, which displayed a number of disputes between the pair. Additionally, it enabled access to a bonus feature, which included various techniques for killing amphibious targets.<ref name="Curse of the Black Hole Pirates">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''</ref>

Sometimes after the publication of ''The Bounty Hunters' Guild's Greatest Hits: Volume VII'' the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] owned a pirated version of the holofilm. He hoped to learn more tricks how to eliminate amphibious targets, but he could only laugh at the information and the disputes between the two [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bounty hunters.<ref name="Curse of the Black Hole Pirates" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Bounty Hunters' Guild's Greatest Hits: Volume VII'' was first mentioned in the second novel of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions|''The Clone Wars Secret Missions'' series]], [[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates|''Curse of the Black Hole Pirates'']], published in July of 2010 and written by [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/clonewars_penguin_fall2010/index.html|text=Look Inside ''Villains: A Pop-Up Storybook'' and More!}}</ref>
